title: 🍎 Where’s Trump? Just Check Under the Fruit Crates!
text:
🍎 Where’s Trump? Just Check Under the Fruit Crates!"

"The president’s sneaky getaway from Ankara Airport—reportedly via a catering service truck—has become prime roast material for the global media. Now, the internet’s satirical artists are having a field day, hilariously photoshopping him crouching nervously beneath towering piles of fruit boxes. Because when you're planning a covert exit, nothing screams "undercover" quite like hiding among the apples and bananas! 🍌🥭
